messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "rosuvastatin calcium"
set: ["rosuvastatin calcium", "Rosuvastatin", "calcium", "allergy to rosuvastatin", "generic rosuvastatin tablets", "Atorvastatin calcium", "increased calcium", "Calcium lactate", "Calcium carbonate", "higher doses of Rosuvastatin", "high calcium levels", "low calcium level", "Calcium channel blockers", "Atorvastatin calcium oral suspension", "monitor for increased calcium", "tribasic calcium phosphate NF"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
